theater: 南非德蘭士瓦與奧蘭治自由邦

battle.name: 第二次波耳戰爭
battle.theater: 南非德蘭士瓦與奧蘭治自由邦
battle.brief: 一八九九年十月起，英國聯同殖民地部隊同南非德蘭士瓦及奧蘭治自由邦兩個波耳共和國交戰，戰線涵蓋納塔爾與德蘭士瓦高原，歷時近三年，以維勒尼京和約收場。加特林機槍喺呢場戰爭只剩少量隨英軍工程兵與裝甲列車服役，以六管人力轉動提供固定據點嘅近距離火力，主導權已經交畀水冷式皮帶餵彈重機槍。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰分兩方。英國一方以本土常備軍為骨干：步兵營、皇家炮兵、皇家工程兵、印度軍同皇家海軍，再加遍及帝國嘅殖民地與屬地部隊，包括開普殖民地民兵與義勇騎兵、納塔爾民兵、澳大利亞維多利亞、昆士蘭同新南威爾斯等州嘅義勇騎槍團、紐西蘭志願騎槍兵與步兵連、加拿大騎槍兵同皇家加拿大龍騎兵、錫蘭山民兵、印度騎兵與山炮隊，以及羅德西亞同南非公司嘅武裝人員。指揮系統分層：陸軍大臣喺倫敦掌資源，駐南非最高專員掌政務，總司令先後由雷德弗斯·布勒少將同羅伯茨勛爵出任，參謀長由基奇納勛爵長期擔任。前線再分科曼切克同金伯利方向（梅休恩勛爵領軍）、萊迪史密斯防禦區（喬治·懷特少將）、北開普同奧蘭治河方向嘅機動縱隊。波耳一方係德蘭士瓦（南非共和國）同奧蘭治自由邦兩個共和國，前者由總統保羅·克魯格主持，後者由總統斯蒂恩主持，兩國各自有國民軍、炮兵同四十多支由市鎮青年組成嘅 commando 游擊隊；開普殖民地部分阿非利堪人志願加入，形成所謂「開普叛軍」。波耳一方仲有外籍技術人員同炮手，德國同奧地利人為佢哋組裝同操作新式野戰砲；英方則有來自帝國各地嘅國際志願兵同義勇騎兵團。
countriesEn: The war divided into two sides. The British side was built on the regular army of the United Kingdom: infantry battalions, the Royal Artillery, the Royal Engineers, the Indian Army and the Royal Navy, reinforced by contingents from every corner of the empire. These included the Cape Colony militia and volunteer mounted men, the Natal militia, the volunteer mounted rifle units of the Australian colonies of Victoria, Queensland and New South Wales, the New Zealand Mounted Rifles and infantry companies, the Canadian Mounted Rifles and Royal Canadian Dragoons, the Ceylon Mounted Infantry, Indian cavalry and mountain batteries, and the armed men of Rhodesia and the South Africa Company. The chain of command was layered: the Secretary of State for War in London controlled the resources, the High Commissioner in South Africa handled political questions, the Commander-in-Chief was first Sir Redvers Buller and then Lord Roberts, and Lord Kitchener served for years as Chief of Staff. In the field the war was split again, with a column under Lord Methuen for Kimberley and the Northern Cape, the defence of Ladysmith under Major-General George White, and mobile columns on the Orange River and the Transvaal side. The Boer side was two republics, the South African Republic, the Transvaal, under President Paul Kruger and the Orange Free State under President M. T. Steyn, each with its own Volksraad, state artillery and some forty commandos of mounted riflemen raised from the towns; a section of Afrikaners in the Cape Colony volunteered on the other side and formed the so-called Cape rebels. Foreigners served on the Boer side too: German and Austrian technicians and gunners assembled and operated their modern field guns, while the British drew on international volunteers and yeomanry from across the empire.
people: 保羅·克魯格係德蘭士瓦嘅核心人物，做咗三十年總統，堅持用遊戲方式處理英國要求，即係喺槍口下舉行公民表決；一八九八年嘅公民表決以大比數拒絕畀外國居民投票權，一八九九年十月二日佢再拒絕英國最後通牒，戰爭隨即爆發。英方將領方面，羅伯茨勛爵一八〇〇年接任總司令，率軍攻入奧蘭治自由邦，先後占領布隆方丹同比勒陀利亞，再以追擊殘敵嘅姿態打消耗戰；基奇納勛爵做參謀長，實際主導情報、破壞同焦土命令；布勒少將喺納塔爾主戰，初戰不利後被撤換；梅休恩勛爵領科曼切克解圍，失敗後於一九〇〇年二月喺馬格斯方丹受重創；喬治·懷特少將守萊迪史密斯，頂住四個月包圍。波耳將領入面，彼得·克魯尼耶最有影響，他用密集縱隊封鎖馬格斯方丹正面，令英軍夜襲全線崩潰，自己亦因傷重喺二月二日身亡；克利斯蒂安·德·韋特係自由邦最具決定性嘅指揮官，以分割、滲透、破壞同游擊拖住英軍；路易斯·博塔、雅各布·斯穆茨同 J. B. M. 赫措格亦係關鍵人物，斯穆茨以西開普游擊隊發起人身份出現，並喺戰爭尾段代表波耳方面談判。另有羅德·巴登-鮑威爾以數百人守瑪費京二百一十七日，靠迫擊砲同幾門小型砲位拖住包圍者。開普殖民地嘅阿非利堪人志願者同德國、奥地利外籍炮手，亦喺戰線上扮演過重要角色。
peopleEn: Paul Kruger was the central figure on the Transvaal side. He had been president for thirty years and insisted on handling Britain's demands in his own way, which was to put them to the country in a plebiscite held under the guns. The plebiscite of 1898 rejected by a large majority the extension of the vote to foreign residents, and on 2 October 1899 he rejected the British ultimatum once more, and the war followed. Among the British commanders, Lord Roberts took over as Commander-in-Chief in 1900, led the army into the Orange Free State, occupied Bloemfontein and Pretoria in turn, and then fought the war of attrition in the posture of a man chasing a beaten enemy; Lord Kitchener, as Chief of Staff, actually directed intelligence, demolition and the scorched earth order; Sir Redvers Buller fought in Natal, was beaten at first and was relieved; Lord Methuen led the relief of Kimberley and was badly hit at Magersfontein in February 1900 after his failure; Major-General George White held Ladysmith through four months of siege. On the Boer side the most influential commander was Piet Cronjé, who massed his columns on the front at Magersfontein and broke the British night attack from end to end, dying of his wounds on 2 February; Christiaan de Wet of the Free State was the most decisive of the Boer commanders, holding the British with division, infiltration, destruction and commando warfare; Louis Botha, Jan Smuts and J. B. M. Hertzog were likewise key men, Smuts appearing first as the organiser of the western Cape commandos and later as the Boer negotiator in the closing phase. Robert Baden-Powell held Mafeking with a few hundred men for two hundred and seventeen days, using his mortars and a handful of small guns to hold off the besiegers. Afrikaner volunteers in the Cape Colony and the German and Austrian foreign gunners also played significant parts on the battlefield.
kits: 加特林機槍喺呢場戰爭入面已經係上一代裝備。一八六〇年出廠嘅六管人力轉動機槍，靠手搖曲柄令六支槍管依次後退裝填，後坐力分散喺六次擊發之間，一八六四年之後嘅改型射速可達每分鐘四百發，有效射程八百至一千碼；英國喺一八七〇至八〇年代由美國購入一批，用於祖魯戰爭、埃及戰役同蘇丹遠征，一八八五年蘇丹戰役時已經改用新式金屬殼藥。喺南非戰場上，加特林機槍數量極少，主要由皇家工程兵同少量騎兵部隊持有，架喺固定陣地、圍城防線、碉堡同裝甲列車上，作用係對密集攻擊嘅步兵提供持續火力；一八八一年英波戰爭中被波耳繳獲嘅兩門加特林機槍，喺第二次波耳戰爭期間仍然由波耳炮兵使用，戰後先交回英方。真正支撐英軍火力嘅係水冷式皮帶餵彈重機槍，佢可以連續射擊而唔使停機換管，佔據咗機槍位置。步槍方面，英軍用栓動式李-恩菲爾德步槍，係 .303 口徑；波耳軍用毛瑟七毫米同八毫米步槍。砲兵方面，英軍有十二磅、十五磅同六磅野戰砲、三十磅重砲、四點五吋同五吋臼炮，以及配備一磅快射砲嘅騎兵同裝甲列車；波耳軍有法國克雷梭同德國克魯伯野戰砲，同繳獲嘅英軍四點五吋臼炮，攻城重砲則靠外籍技師操作。運輸同後勤方面，英軍靠騾車、牛車、鐵路同大批役馬運補，裝甲列車以蒸汽機車拉動裝甲貨車，車上設砲位同觀察台；波耳軍以馬匹為主，每支 commando 隊自備馬匹同乾糧，行軍縱深大，但補給完全靠就地徵集。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun was already a previous generation of weapon in this war. The six-barrel hand-cranked model of 1860 was worked by a crank that made the six barrels recoil and reload in turn, spreading the recoil across six separate discharges; modifications of 1864 raised the rate of fire to four hundred rounds a minute with an effective range of eight hundred to a thousand yards. Britain bought a batch from the United States in the 1870s and 1880s and used them in the Zulu War, the Egyptian campaign and the Sudan expeditions, the 1885 Sudan campaign already showing them adapted to the new metallic cartridge. In South Africa the number of Gatling guns was very small. They were held chiefly by the Royal Engineers and a few mounted units, emplaced in fixed positions, on siege lines, in blockhouses and on armoured trains, their task being to lay down sustained fire against infantry attacking in mass. The two Gatling guns captured by the Boers in the First Boer War of 1881 were still in Boer hands and in use by the Boer artillery during the Second Boer War, and were handed back to the British afterwards. What actually carried the British firepower was the water-cooled belt-fed machine gun, the Maxim, which could fire continuously without stopping to change barrels and so occupied the machine gun position. In rifles the British used the bolt-action Lee-Enfield in .303 calibre, while the Boer forces carried Mauser rifles of seven and eight millimetres. In artillery the British had twelve-, fifteen- and six-pounder field guns, thirty-pounders, four and a half inch and five inch howitzers, and a one-pounder quick-firer, the pom-pom, mounted on cavalry carriages and armoured trains; the Boers had French Creusot and German Krupp field guns and captured British four and a half inch howitzers, and their heavy siege pieces were worked by foreign technicians. On the logistics side the British moved supplies by mule cart, ox wagon, railway and a great many remounts, the armoured trains being steam locomotives hauling armoured wagons fitted with gun positions and observation platforms; the Boer forces were mounted and each commando team carried its own horses and rations, marching with great depth of column but living entirely on what could be taken from the country.
tactics: 雙方戰術差異極大。波耳軍用 commando 制度：每支隊伍係幾十至幾百名騎槍手，自備馬匹，行動時散開成散兵線，慣喺八百至一千五百碼外放槍，射完即轉移，多數戰鬥喺幾分鐘內結束，傷兵由同伴帶走，極少被圍殲。防守上，波耳人善用山脊、石堆圍牆、礦區坑口同樹林，喺馬格斯方丹把縱隊密集排在正面斜坡，令英軍以為對面空無一人而遭側面火力打擊；喺斯皮恩科普則以據點群阻擋英軍夜襲。英軍初期照搬英式正面推進加側翼迂迴，結果喺斯皮恩科普、馬格斯方丹同帕爾德貝格三連敗，之後改為結合砲兵縱射、步兵分批攻擊同工兵築城：先用重砲、攻城砲同迫擊砲遠程壓制，再由步兵分批推進，喺掩體後逐段清剿。攻擊時英軍用密集縱隊，砲隊先清空敵方前線；德·韋特則以小股騎兵滲透，切斷英軍縱隊嘅糧道同鐵路，令推進速度大減。一九〇〇年之後戰爭轉入消耗戰：英軍以縱隊追擊、用封鎖線同碉堡逐步收縮波耳控制區，並用騎兵搜索隊配合武裝偵察把游擊隊逼入死角；一九〇一年八月起實施焦土政策，摧毀農莊、沒收牲畜，切斷游擊隊嘅補給來源。英軍亦用氣球同裝甲列車做偵察與火力支援，並喺戰場上首次使用可操縱嘅氣球升空觀察，同時放出早期軍用飛艇；波耳方面則把騎槍手分成數百人一支嘅小隊，晝夜輪替騷擾，令英軍搜索線疲於奔命。
tacticsEn: The two sides fought entirely differently. The Boers worked through the commando system: each unit was some dozens to several hundred mounted riflemen who brought their own horses, rode out in loose skirmish order, habitually opened fire at eight hundred to fifteen hundred yards, and moved off as soon as they had emptied their magazines, so that most actions were over in minutes and the wounded were carried away by their own comrades rather than being surrounded and destroyed. In defence the Boers used ridges, stone kraals, mine shafts and bush, and at Magersfontein they massed their columns on the front slope so that the British would believe the position empty and be caught by fire from the flank; at Spion Kop they held a group of fortified posts against the British night attack. The British at first fought the European way, frontal advance combined with envelopment, and were beaten in succession at Spion Kop, Magersfontein and Paardeberg; they then changed to a combination of artillery preparation, infantry attacks delivered in waves and engineer works, first silencing the enemy front with heavy guns, siege guns and mortars, then advancing in bounds behind cover and clearing the ground section by section. On the attack the British marched in dense columns with the artillery first emptying the opposing front; de Wet answered with small mounted parties that cut the supply lines and the railway of the British columns and slowed their advance sharply. After 1900 the war became one of attrition: the British pursued in columns, tightened the cordon and the blockhouse lines around the area the Boers still held, and used mounted search parties together with armed scouts to drive the commandos into corners; from August 1901 the scorched earth policy began, farms burned and stock confiscated, cutting the guerrillas off from their supplies. The British also used balloons and armoured trains for reconnaissance and fire support, and for the first time in war raised balloons for observation and brought an early military airship over the battlefield; on the Boer side the mounted riflemen were broken into parties of a few hundred that relieved one another day and night, so that the British search lines were kept on the run.
data: 可以核對嘅數字大致如下：戰爭由一八九九年十月三日開戰（英方最後通牒喺十月二日答覆），至一九〇二年五月三十一日喺弗里尼京簽訂和約為止，前後約兩年零八個月。帝國先後出動兵力逾四十萬人，戰事高峰在南非嘅英軍約二十五萬，其中英國本土常備軍佔少數，大批係殖民地同義勇部隊；波耳兩共和國可徵召男性約十一萬，實際同時喺戰線上作戰者一般估為兩萬五至三萬人。砲兵方面，德蘭士瓦一方開戰時有數十門新式野戰砲同重型攻城砲，主要係法國克雷梭同德國克魯伯製品。傷亡以官方同後世統計為準：英軍陣亡約千人，負傷約二千餘人；波耳方面陣亡約四千人、負傷約六千人。個別會戰數字更大：馬格斯方丹英軍傷亡約一千二百人，斯皮恩科普逾一千人，帕爾德貝格約一千五百人上下，兩名英軍主將被俘。海軍方面，一九〇〇年二月十五日「好望號」同「赫爾德萊因號」巡洋艦喺阿古拉斯海角外海被波耳岸防重砲擊沉，兩艦共有六百餘名水兵陣亡。物資上，庫房裡嘅加特林機槍數目以數門計，遠少過水冷式重機槍以數百挺計嘅規模；英軍損失嘅軍馬與騾子以數萬匹計。戰爭總支出方面，官方帳目顯示英國一方花費逾一億英鎊。戰役數以百計，被英方編入正式戰鬥記錄者亦達數十場，單係圍城就有萊迪史密斯、馬格斯方丹、金伯利與瑪費京數處長期對峙。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war began on 3 October 1899, the British ultimatum having been answered on 2 October, and ended with the treaty signed at Vereeniging on 31 May 1902, a matter of about two years and eight months in all. The Empire put more than four hundred thousand men into the field over the course of the war, with about a quarter of a million British and colonial troops in South Africa at the height of the fighting, only a minority of them regulars from Britain, the rest drawn from the colonies and the volunteer forces; the two Boer republics could raise perhaps a hundred and ten thousand men, and the number actually fighting on the front line at any one time was generally estimated at between twenty-five and thirty thousand. In the artillery the Transvaal fielded several dozen modern field guns and heavy siege pieces at the outbreak, mainly French Creusot and German Krupp. On casualties the official and later figures run: the British about one thousand dead and rather more than two thousand wounded, while the Boer dead were put at about four thousand and the wounded at about six thousand. The larger actions cost more: at Magersfontein the British lost about twelve hundred men, at Spion Kop rather more than a thousand, and at Paardeberg around fifteen hundred, two British commanders being taken prisoner. At sea, on 15 February 1900, the cruisers HMS Good Hope and HMS Helderlein were sunk by heavy Boer coastal guns off the Agulhas Bank, more than six hundred of their men being killed. In stores, Gatling guns were counted in single figures, a scale far below the hundreds of water-cooled machine guns; the British also lost tens of thousands of horses and mules. On cost, the official accounts show the British side spending more than one hundred million pounds sterling. The number of engagements ran into the hundreds, of which several dozen were entered as formal battles in British records, and sieges alone included the long blockades of Ladysmith, Magersfontein, Kimberley and Mafeking.
cause: 打起來嘅原因係幾層加埋。一八九五年詹姆森突擊之後，英國唔係唔想和解，但南非共和國拒絕將投票權讓畀外國居民：一八九四年嘅投票權法案被國民大會否決，一八九八年嘅公民表決又以壓倒多數拒絕英方方案，英國商界同開普殖民地嘅英裔居民開始認為德蘭士瓦嘅獨裁正在威脅自身利益。直接導火線係地下資源嘅變化：一八八〇年代之後威特沃特斯蘭德嘅金礦產量急升，約翰尼斯堡由礦場聚落變成南非最大嘅工業城市，外來人口大量湧入，兩國嘅經濟重心同政治權力已經唔對等。英國嘅戰爭目標係重申一八八一年比勒陀利亞條約同一八八四年倫敦條約賦予嘅權利，並以外國居民取得同樣選舉權作為恢復舊憲法嘅條件；戰爭其實係第一次波耳戰爭嘅延續，一八八一年嗰次以英國撤退收場，之後十二年雙方一直互相指責同暗中備戰。波耳一方嘅訴求係保住共和國主權、限制外來人口嘅選舉權、維持獨立外交，並得到奧蘭治自由邦支持；開普殖民地部分阿非利堪人同情佢哋，令戰火一旦蔓延到開普就再難收拾。背景上，兩個共和國財政吃緊、鐵路只到邊境、軍隊以民團為主，但內陸廣闊同騎兵嘅機動性，令佢哋可以靠固守消耗入侵者。
causeEn: There were several layers of cause. After the Jameson Raid of 1895 Britain was not unwilling to settle, but the South African Republic refused to widen the franchise for foreign residents: the Franchise Bill of 1894 was rejected by the Volksraad, and the plebiscite of 1898 rejected the British scheme by an overwhelming majority, while the British commercial community and the British population of the Cape Colony came to see Transvaal autocracy as a threat to their own interests. The immediate cause lay in what was under the ground. After the great gold discoveries of the 1880s the output of the Witwatersrand rose steeply, Johannesburg grew from a mining camp into the largest industrial city in South Africa, foreign population poured in, and the economic weight of the two states no longer matched their political weight. The British war aim was to assert the rights of the Pretoria Convention of 1881 and the London Convention of 1884, and to make the franchise for foreign residents the price of restoring the old constitution; in substance the war was a continuation of the First Boer War, which had ended in 1881 with a British withdrawal, after which the two sides had blamed each other and prepared in secret for twelve years. The Boer claims were the preservation of the sovereignty of the republics, the restriction of the franchise for new arrivals and the keeping of an independent foreign policy, and they were backed by the Orange Free State, while in the Cape Colony a section of the Afrikaners sympathised with them, which meant that once the war reached the Cape it could never be brought to an end. Against a background of strained finances, railways that stopped at the border and an army of militia, the breadth of the interior and the mobility of mounted men allowed the Boers to wear down the invader from fixed positions.
impact: 第一層後果係兩個波耳共和國消失。一九〇二年和約之後，德蘭士瓦變成英王直轄嘅德蘭士瓦殖民地，奧蘭治自由邦變成奧蘭治河殖民地，兩地保留內部自治但主權歸英國，之後喺一九一〇年合併成南非聯邦，博塔做第一任總理、斯穆茨做第一任總統。軍事上，英國喺呢場戰爭之後重整指揮體系，一八九九年成立嘅參謀學院後來遷到坎伯里，一九〇九年正式成立帝國總參謀部；騎兵、步兵同砲兵嘅協同、戰地通訊同鐵路補給都得到一次大規模實戰檢驗，加特林機槍亦喺呢一輪之後徹底退出一線，機槍位由水冷式皮帶餵彈重機槍取代。另外，呢場戰爭係歷史上第一次有空軍參與地面戰役：英軍成立氣球部隊升空觀察，飛艇亦曾現身，裝甲列車同機槍共同構成第一批現代化機動火力。國際上，德國同奧地利人為波耳服務一事引發列強對英國在南非擴張嘅批評，德國於一九〇六年通過海軍法向英國挑戰，此後英德海軍競賽成為國際關係主線之一。政治上，漫長嘅焦土戰同集中營制度令阿非利堪反英情緒喺開普固化，一九〇六年嘅「不情願革命」同一九一一年嘅國民黨成立都係呢段經歷嘅延續；英國本土則為高昂嘅戰費同大量帝國志願兵嘅參戰，重新思考帝國嘅編制同成本。最後，呢場戰爭成為現代戰爭文學同攝影嘅重要題材，大量戰地報道、戰地照片同回憶錄流傳，塑造咗後世對帝國戰爭嘅想像。
impactEn: The first consequence was the disappearance of the two Boer republics. After the treaty of 1902 the Transvaal became the Transvaal Colony and the Orange Free State the Orange River Colony, both under the British Crown with internal self-government, and they were merged into the Union of South Africa in 1910, with Botha as first prime minister and Smuts as first president. On the military side the war forced a reorganisation of the British command system: the Staff College, founded in 1899 and later moved to Camberley, led to the imperial General Staff of 1909, and the coordination of cavalry, infantry and artillery, the field telegraph and railway supply were all put to the test of a war on a scale never seen before, after which the Gatling gun left the front line for good, its place taken by the belt-fed water-cooled machine gun. The war was also the first in history in which the air took part in a land battle: the British raised a balloon company, an airship was flown over the battlefield for observation, and armoured trains working with machine guns formed the first modern mobile firepower. Internationally, the fact that German and Austrians served the Boers drew criticism from the powers of Britain's expansion in southern Africa, and Germany challenged Britain with its Naval Act of 1906, after which the Anglo-German naval race became one of the main lines of international affairs. In politics the long scorched earth war and the system of concentration camps hardened Afrikaner anti-British feeling in the Cape: the Reluctant Revolution of 1906 and the founding of the National Party in 1911 both grew out of this experience, while in Britain the enormous cost of the war and the numbers of imperial volunteers who served led to a fresh reckoning of what the empire cost and how it was organised. Finally the war became a major subject of modern war literature and photography, and the flood of despatches, photographs and memoirs shaped later generations' picture of imperial warfare.
result: 結果係英軍取得全面軍事勝利，但波耳方以議價換取政權，而唔係被徹底消滅。一九〇〇年三月英軍入布隆方丹，五月羅伯茨嘅騎兵縱隊推進到比勒陀利亞外圍，六月五日英軍正式占領比勒陀利亞；一九〇一年之後戰事轉入游擊階段，德·韋特同斯穆茨喺南部邊境同開普各地持續作戰，英軍以封鎖線、縱隊掃蕩、焦土政策同從當地招募嘅武裝偵察逐步收緊，至一九〇二年五月，德·韋特喺開普被俘，波耳代表同英方喺弗里尼京嘅梅爾羅斯府簽訂和約：兩個共和國放棄獨立，但以自治殖民地形式保留內部行政同選舉，德國與奧地利外籍人則被遣返，英軍保留為期五年嘅駐紮。戰後波耳將領仍有一批留喺德蘭士瓦執政，兩地阿非利堪人佔多數，選舉權問題並未真正解決，一九〇八年嘅「不情願革命」同此後嘅民族主義運動，正係由呢次和約留下嘅縫隙生出，一般形容為礦產歸英人、農地歸波耳人嘅分配更加深咗呢層矛盾。軍事層面上，加特林機槍完成咗佢喺英軍序列入面嘅最後一場戰爭：作為少數固定火力點同裝甲列車武器，佢喺一九〇〇年之後退出服役，而水冷式重機槍、連鎖步槍同德國製造嘅毛瑟步槍，就成為下一次大戰嘅標準配備。
resultEn: The result was a complete British military victory, but the Boers bought the political survival of their republics by negotiation rather than being annihilated. The British entered Bloemfontein in March 1900, Roberts's mounted column pushed to the outskirts of Pretoria in May, and Pretoria was formally occupied on 5 June; from 1901 the war became a guerrilla war, de Wet and Smuts carrying on the fight along the southern borders and through the Cape, while the British tightened the cordon, swept with columns, burned farms and recruited armed scouts from the local population. By May 1902 de Wet had been taken in the Cape, and the Boer representatives signed the peace at Melrose House in Vereeniging: the two republics gave up independence but kept internal administration and elections as self-governing colonies, the foreign German and Austrian volunteers were sent home, and the British kept a garrison for five years. Several Boer leaders stayed on to govern the Transvaal, the Afrikaners were a majority in both colonies, and the franchise question was not truly settled: the Reluctant Revolution of 1908 and the nationalist movement that followed grew out of the gaps left by that peace, a division usually described as the mines going to the British and the farms to the Boers having deepened the quarrel. On the military side the Gatling gun fought its last war in the British order of battle, as a handful of fixed firing points and as an armoured train weapon; after 1900 it left service, while the water-cooled machine gun, the repeating rifle and the German Mauser became the standard equipment of the next great war.
